about_the_game:
A battle royale where everyone is CaseOh… and you eat the entire world.

This is a real multiplayer game with actual players, no bots, and pure chaos. Drop into massive city full of CaseOh's. Start small, eat objects to grow bigger, then consume buildings, landmarks, and eventually other players to become the biggest CaseOh on the map.

Every object has value. Every bite makes you stronger. One wrong move and you’re the one getting eaten.

Use powerful abilities like Loki, Ghost, Fart, and Super CaseOh to escape, juke enemies, or pull players straight into your mouth. Unlock skins, taglines, icons, and power-ups through gameplay, the shop, or the battle pass. Win matches, earn coins and gems, flex your victory crown, and prove you’re the last CaseOh standing.

If you’ve ever wanted to eat an entire city… this is your moment.

name: Skylark

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: i3-4160 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 950 / AMD 270 (min 2GB video ram)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 4770K, 3.4 Ghz or AMD Ryzen 5 1600, 3.2 Ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 480, 8GB
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: In this action-adventure game, you are an ex-mafia member who seeks revenge for the death of your best friend. Receive upgrades when defeating mafia bosses. Throughout the game, you can upgrade your powers and decide to either take over the city or free it from anyone of high power.
